n) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution and responds `202` immediately** with the `runId`. Validation and quota errors

ere it came from, the counts with the population they count, the run's own verdict decision when it has one, and one page of per-t

n: \"TRACE_NOT_AVAILABLE\"` when the iteration finished without a stored trace.\n- [Get an iteration's step results](https://docs.

k`/`fail`/`skipped`/`pending`), a `reason`, and any `evidence` (screenshots, replay-video offset, widget tool calls). The fastest

(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/cancel-a-run.md): Request cancellation of an in-flight run; marks the run and its
